# ResearchIQ

> ResearchIQ is a single-owner research intelligence app. A FastAPI backend pulls papers and repositories from public sources (arXiv, Semantic Scholar, GitHub, Hugging Face, CrossRef, PubMed) over plain HTTP connectors, stores them as a graph in Neo4j with a MongoDB mirror, and uses a Groq-hosted LLM for reviews, surveys, gaps, roadmaps, comparisons and chat. A React and Vite frontend sits on top. The API is private: every /api route requires the owner's token, and there is no public API or hosted docs site.

Notes for agents working in this repository:
- The connectors in backend/app/mcp/ are ordinary HTTP clients and do not use the Model Context Protocol.
- Blocking Neo4j, Mongo and PDF-store calls must not run directly in async code; wrap them with run_in_threadpool. A test enforces this.
- Untrusted text must never become an HTML string in the frontend; use JSX, d3 .text() or the Markdown component. ESLint enforces this.
- Paper ids go through canonical_paper_id in backend/app/db/ids.py so one paper is one node.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ramnnn2006/research-intelligence/blob/main/README.md): features, architecture, Neo4j data model, setup and running the app

## Code

- [API routes](https://github.com/ramnnn2006/research-intelligence/blob/main/backend/app/api/routes.py): HTTP endpoints
- [API access control](https://github.com/ramnnn2006/research-intelligence/blob/main/backend/app/api/security.py): single-owner token authentication
- [LLM agent](https://github.com/ramnnn2006/research-intelligence/blob/main/backend/app/agents/research_agent.py): prompts, JSON parsing and the default Groq model
- [Source connectors](https://github.com/ramnnn2006/research-intelligence/tree/main/backend/app/mcp): arXiv, Semantic Scholar, GitHub, Hugging Face, CrossRef, PubMed
- [Database layer](https://github.com/ramnnn2006/research-intelligence/tree/main/backend/app/db): Neo4j, MongoDB, paper id normalization
- [Frontend](https://github.com/ramnnn2006/research-intelligence/tree/main/frontend/src): React pages and components

## Tests and checks

- [Backend tests](https://github.com/ramnnn2006/research-intelligence/tree/main/tests): pytest against real Neo4j and MongoDB
- [CI workflow](https://github.com/ramnnn2006/research-intelligence/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml): pytest with Neo4j and MongoDB services, frontend lint, tests and build
